title: The Creator seed flow launches with the Owner's defaults: two touches for a cold lead, email off and only to opted-in addresses, and a ref on every tagged link
description: Launch plan v2, the Owner's best-practice decisions of 2026-11-11 for flows/neighborhood-activation. A cold lead (its first touch came from a hunt, and no draft marked it warm) gets at most two touches, day 0 and about day 5; any reply or no still ends it. The setting is sequence.cold_max_touches (2) in the flow's config.json; leads.max_touches_per_lead stays the lifetime cap of three, and a warm lead still gets touch 3 about day 12. The sequence closes a cold lead at the cap, so GET /v1/flows/{key}/sequence never shows it due and Today leaves its waiting draft off. Email sends stay off: the shipped config sets sequence.email_batch_approval false, so a batch at Draft hands nothing to the outbox. Marketing email goes only to opted-in addresses: with sequence.email_opt_in_only true, an email touch is offered only to a lead with an opt-in marker (opted_in_at, or opt_in true), and batch approval refuses an email draft without one (no_opt_in). Link tags: utm_source stays flowweb (existing checks and Frequency attribution key on it); every seed link and every tagged draft link also carries ref=<draft tag>, so one draft can be learned from on its own. leads.max_new_contacts_per_day stays 15 and DEFAULT_INTENSITY.per_day stays 10.
acceptance: The shipped config sets sequence.email_batch_approval false, sequence.cold_max_touches 2 and sequence.email_opt_in_only true, and keeps leads.max_touches_per_lead 3 and leads.max_new_contacts_per_day 15
A cold lead with two touches sent is closed and never due; a warm lead with two is due for touch 3
Today leaves off a cold lead's third draft and keeps a warm lead's
A lead with no opt-in marker is not offered an email touch, and batch approval refuses its email draft
With email batch approval off, nothing reaches the outbox
Seed links and tagged draft links carry ref=<tag> and keep utm_source=flowweb
